name: api-gateway-backend-security-and-rate-limiting
description: >- Secures and rate limits backend services behind Google Cloud API Gateway across OpenAPI 2.0 and OpenAPI 3.0.x API configurations, including MCP-enabled gateways. Use when configuring API key or JWT authentication, locking down Cloud Run or Cloud Run functions backends with a gateway service account, reading authenticated claims from X-Apigateway-Api-Userinfo, setting per-project request quotas, or diagnosing HTTP 429 and HTTP 500 Service Control Quota errors. Do not use for Apigee, GKE Gatewa
author: google
